entities.summary: Thomas Ruff (b. 1958-02-10, Zell am Harmersbach) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zell am Harmersbach and Germany. Known in the fields of authors & novelists.
